renderer: Complete export: Rust procedural baseline, then Sharp SVG overrides for Horizon and CrystalWire

authoritative_source.procedural: renderer/src/suite.rs (Command, Ghost, Vault, PDF, Spaces, Mail)
authoritative_source.outline: svg/horizon.svg, svg/crystalwire.svg; optical sizing and export in svg/render.cjs

profile: release; opt-level=3; no custom target-cpu or fast-math flags
ico_encoding: 32-bit BGRA DIB entries below 256; PNG at 256
pdf_document_icons: Preserved legacy ICOs; not generated by this renderer

optional_tools.Pillow: 12.3.0, PDF installer preview and executable icon comparison only

vault_reference: references/vault-circuit-reference.png; used for visual direction only, not embedded by the renderer
